Graduate Admission FAQ
Find answers to frequently asked questions about the admission process at Saint Louis
University, including information about transcripts, financial aid and more.
The Application Process
Graduate admission requirements at Saint Louis University may vary by program. Contact
the department directly for minimum test scores and other required materials. You
can find contact information, as well as additional admission requirements, on degree-specific pages or answers to frequently asked admission questions below:
How much is the graduate application fee to Saint Louis University?
SLU's application portal does not require an application fee. If you are using a centralized application service
like SOPHAS, ATCAS, CSDCAS, HAMPCAS, etc., you will be required to pay the application fee charged by these centralized
services.
How do I find out the status of my graduate admission application?
You can check your application status by logging into your SLU application account. If you applied using a service such as SOPHAS, AMCAS and others, please return to
your original application system.
Can I apply to more than one program?
Yes. The University offers several pre-approved dual degree programs. SLU also considers
any requests to enroll in two programs and pursue multiple degrees at the same time
on a case-by-case basis.
Contact the departments of both programs to determine the eligibility and policies
for concurrent enrollment. If you wish to pursue a dual degree, you will need to apply
to and be accepted by both degree programs.
Can I send my supporting documents, such as letters of recommendation and transcripts,
separately from my application?
We accept documents sent separately; however, we are able to process applications
more quickly when an application has been submitted with all its supporting documents.
Our user-friendly application portal ensures a smooth experience, allowing you to upload, review and edit your documents
before you submit the application. Should you have any questions about the application
process, please contact the Graduate Admission Office at graduate@slu.edu.
What is Saint Louis University's institution code for submitting GRE scores?
SLU's institution code is 6629, and test scores should be submitted electronically by the testing organization to
the University.
What is the minimum GRE score required for graduate admission?
Each department has different requirement standards for graduate admission tests such
as the GRE. Contact the individual program or department for specific information regarding test scores and other admission
requirements.
Transcripts
Your academic transcripts will be required for graduate admission to Saint Louis University.
Learn more below:
Can I apply to a graduate program with unofficial copies of university transcripts
or GRE scores?
Some graduate programs will review applications for admission with unofficial transcripts.
Please reach out to the department or Graduate Admission directly at graduate@slu.edu to confirm. Official transcripts will be required to register for coursework at SLU.
I received my undergraduate degree from Saint Louis University. Do I still need to
send my transcripts to the Graduate Admission office?
No. If Saint Louis University is indicated on your education history during the application
process, the Office of the Registrar will automatically send a copy of your transcript.
Do I need to send transcripts from every college I have previously attended?
Yes. We will need all transcripts from all previous colleges or universities attended.
Tuition and Financial Aid
Saint Louis University's graduate tuition and fees vary by specific program.
See a Current Schedule of Tuition & Fees
Assistantships are awarded by individual programs or departments and usually require
you to assist with teaching, research or other departmental duties. As part of your
application, you’ll be asked to indicate whether you are interested in an assistantship,
but you should also check with your program to see if any additional application is
required. The program or department can provide you with details on the availability
of assistantships.
Fellowships are awarded to newly accepted master's or doctoral level students who
demonstrate outstanding scholastic achievement and potential for success.
More on Graduate Assistantships and Fellowships at SLU
International Student Admission
International students may have additional admission requirements to Saint Louis University's
academic programs. Specific information can be found on degree-specific pages. For general questions, see below:
How much is the graduate application fee to Saint Louis University for international
students?
SLU's application portal does not require an application fee. If you are using a centralized application service
like SOPHAS, ATCAS, CSDCAS, HAMPCAS, etc., you will be required to pay the application fee charged by these centralized
services.
Who do I contact with questions about my visa?
SLU’s Office of International Services can assist you with questions regarding your visa. For questions about your application
or the admission process more generally, contact your graduate admission counselor.
Do I have to submit the Declaration of Finances Form before being accepted?
No, but submitting your declaration of finances when you apply will expedite the processing.
What are the minimum TOEFL scores to be considered for admission?
A score of at least 550 on the paper-based TOEFL or at least 80 on the internet-based
TOEFL is required for admission. Some graduate programs may require a higher score
for English proficiency. Check the listing for your degree program for specific requirements.
The IELTS or PTE can also be used to demonstrate your English language proficiency. Unless you have previously attended a college or university in the United States,
scores from one of these tests must be submitted electronically for your application
to be considered.
